payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the sentence reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks for improving performance in document summarization.

claims.text: Sentence reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task, as it requires comprehensive understanding of a document, which is crucial for abstractive summarization.
Among the three pre-training tasks, SR performs slightly better than next sentence generation (NSG) and masked document generation (MDG).
